definitions.explanation: An outbreak of an infectious disease that spreads across multiple countries or worldwide. The term became widely known in Japanese through the COVID-19 crisis and is now standard vocabulary.

examples.japanese: パンデミックが{世界中|せかいじゅう}に{広|ひろ}がった。
examples.english: The pandemic spread across the world.

examples.japanese: パンデミックの{影響|えいきょう}で{在宅|ざいたく}{勤務|きんむ}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: Remote work increased due to the pandemic.

examples.japanese: パンデミックを{経験|けいけん}したことで、{感染症|かんせんしょう}{対策|たいさく}の{重要性|じゅうようせい}が{広|ひろ}く{認識|にんしき}されるようになった。
examples.english: Having experienced the pandemic, the importance of infectious disease countermeasures became widely recognized.

notes:
USAGE: パンデミック is a loanword from English "pandemic." While the word existed in medical terminology before, it entered everyday Japanese vocabulary during the COVID-19 crisis starting in 2020.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- パンデミックが{発生|はっせい}する (a pandemic breaks out)
- パンデミックの{影響|えいきょう} (the effects of the pandemic)
- パンデミック{対策|たいさく} (pandemic countermeasures)
- パンデミック{前|まえ} / パンデミック{後|ご} (pre-pandemic / post-pandemic)
- コロナパンデミック (the COVID pandemic)

RELATED WORDS:
- {感染症|かんせんしょう} (infectious disease)
- {流行|りゅうこう} (epidemic, outbreak)
- エピデミック (epidemic — more localized than a pandemic)
